_status: ADOPTED for merge-path enforcement by the operator order of 2026-10-19 (P6-CI-6 closure blockers). It governs only the required merge-path gates of .github/workflows/ci.yml (Container build and security; Revision reader). It changes no live environment, no deployment and no publish workflow: staging-publish.yml and reader-publish.yml keep their own Trivy steps and thresholds. security/gate.py enforces exactly what is written here and adopts nothing on its own.

_authority.vulnerability_severity_rules: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19). CRITICAL findings fail in every scope (built images, runtime dependencies, and development, test and security-tool dependencies and installed tooling environments), whether or not a fix is published; neither fix availability, development classification nor missing FixedVersion metadata can filter a CRITICAL out. HIGH findings keep the treatment the merge path enforced before, unchanged: images and runtime dependencies fail when a fix exists (a non-empty FixedVersion, as before); development-scope HIGH findings are reported; unfixed HIGH findings stay listed as EXCLUDED. MEDIUM and LOW findings are reported. NOT RULED BY THE ORDER (the implementation's reading, unchanged from before the adoption, pending an operator ruling): the severity evaluated is Trivy's selected Severity field, so a finding that another source rates CRITICAL but Trivy selects lower is evaluated at Trivy's severity (instance at adoption: CVE-2019-1010022 in libc6/libc-bin, NVD 9.8, Debian and Trivy LOW); and UNKNOWN (unscored) findings are reported like the lower severities (instance at adoption: CVE-2026-82560 in the API image's perl-base, no fix).
_authority.vulnerability_scopes: ADOPTED. Every lock target the filesystem scan reports must be declared as runtime or development below; a target with no declared scope fails the analysis as incomplete, never defaulting to either. npm packages Trivy marks Dev are development scope inside package-lock.json. A built image is image scope. An installed tooling environment (a CI virtual environment or interpreter scanned as installed) is development scope.
_authority.misconfiguration_threshold: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19), unchanged: CRITICAL/HIGH misconfigurations fail. The per-check exception file security/misconfig-exceptions.json (ADOPTED by the operator order of 2026-10-18 for six named findings) is retained unchanged; no exception is broadened. No ignore file is tracked.
_authority.sast_threshold: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19), unchanged: Semgrep ERROR-severity findings fail; WARNING and INFO are reported. Any scanner error (rule timeout, parse failure) is an incomplete analysis and fails closed.
_authority.scanner_errors: ADOPTED, unchanged: a missing or malformed report fails (exit 2); a report that does not describe the claimed artifact or population fails as incomplete (exit 4); a required analysis that left no summary fails completeness.
_authority.sbom: ADOPTED (operator order 2026-10-19), unchanged: CycloneDX 1.5 to 1.7 JSON, validated for format, serial number, described component, non-empty package-component population and, for images, the same image id as the vulnerability report.
